question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: Show the white feather.
solution:
The correct answer is: **To behave timidly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Show the white feather"** refers to displaying cowardice or behaving in a timid manner. (डरपोक होना)

 
 
• **Example:** He showed the white feather by refusing to confront his opponent during the debate.
 
 
 
• Timidly (डरपोक ढंग से) means lacking courage or confidence and acting in a shy or fearful way.
 
 
• **Example:** She timidly approached the stage to give her speech.
 
 
 
• Hence, the meaning of the idiom aligns with the correct option: **To behave timidly**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **To behave timidly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To call for aid **(मदद के लिए बुलाना): Requesting assistance or help in a situation.

 
 
• **Example:** He called for aid when his car broke down on the highway.
 
 
 
• **To show boldness **(साहस दिखाना): Demonstrating courage or bravery in facing challenges.
 
 
• **Example:** She showed boldness by speaking up against injustice.
 
 
 
• **To accept loss proudly **(गर्व से हार स्वीकार करना): Facing defeat with dignity and without complaints.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite losing the competition, he accepted the loss proudly and congratulated the winner.
